title: Caching in ASP.NET Core
description: Use Redis for caching in ASP.NET Core: IMemoryCache, IDistributedCache, response caching, output caching, and cache tagging.
longDescription: ASP.NET Core provides multiple caching abstractions. This module shows how to wire Redis to IMemoryCache, IDistributedCache, response caching, output caching, and cache tagging for invalidation.
whatYouLearn: Apply output caching for full-page caching
